source_note: Compiled by oct7database, a volunteer-run database that links each person to their official memorial record (National Insurance Institute, IDF, Israel Police, Shin Bet, Ministry of Defence).
scope: People killed in the 7 October 2023 attack on Israel from Gaza: those killed that day and those taken hostage that day who died in captivity (the list does not record how). Released or rescued hostages are not included.
note: English and Hebrew names are as oct7database spells them; English spellings are not official. The raw file is not copied into archive/; its sha256 pins the version read.
